judgment_text:
Writ Petition (Criminal) filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, seeking to direct the 6th respondent to defreeze the petitioner's Account in A/C. No. 420157192, held in the Indian Bank, MGT Branch, Chennai, bearing IFSC Code IDIB000M002.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

A.D. Jagadish Chandira, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition (criminal). An endorsement to the said effect was also made by the learned counsel for the petitioner in the petition today. He also circulated a letter dated 06.03.2026 to that effect to the Registry of this Court.

2. In view of the above, this writ petition (criminal) stands dismissed as withdrawn. No costs.
